answer: Copper Bloom Mechanism enforces identity verification through escalating transaction fees. Each new identity starts at the nadir cost of 0.1 tokens for basic actions, but fees rise geometrically with each additional identity owned by the same entity. After five identities, the lagoon threshold blocks further expansion as fees exceed 1 token per action. Verification requires submitting a unique cryptographic proof tied to public records, costing attackers 0.05 tokens per attempt that never matures into full identity status.
